routeGuards.policy: General API token gate; TV loopback is accepted by authed().
Delegates to the Home dispatcher; only its enumerated methods/paths are served; others return 404.

notes: The public listener is dual-stack when supported; the temporary phone setup listener is separate and short-lived.
bodyLimit units reflect current implementation: most JSON handlers count decoded JavaScript string code units, while streamed uploads enforce byte counts.
A null body limit means the route currently has no explicit body-size cap.
